reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0001 expressly states the arrangement is non-exclusive and that the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering Inventory via other agents or selling to third parties, matching the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph.
Deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains, and the rationale documents a reasonable search for restrictive-covenant language elsewhere in the document.
The clause benefits our party, so flagging it as a deviation would be over-flagging; retaining it as internal evidence is appropriate.
